app_info.subtitle: Build and audit Tama graphs
app_info.description: Tama Kit helps developers build, extend, migrate, and audit Tama Terraform graph networks. Its skills guide lifecycle-safe graph authoring and review, while its authenticated MCP tools inspect bounded thread execution history, retrieve diagnostic artifacts, list Reflection feedback, and submit authorized comments for review.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns non-sensitive Tama server identity and protocol capability metadata without changing server or tenant data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads metadata from the authenticated Tama deployment and does not write to public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a bounded page of persisted thread messages and flow pointers without modifying execution history.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads authenticated data from the private Tama deployment and does not affect external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or transition any thread, message, flow, or related record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists bounded step pointers for one thread using optional exact filters without changing stored execution data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only queries the authenticated private Tama deployment and does not publish or transmit changes externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or transition steps or any related execution records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one thread-backed flow, its origin message, branches, and a bounded page of step pointers without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads authenticated execution data from the private Tama deployment and does not change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or transition the flow, its branches, messages, or steps.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves bounded persisted diagnostics, ancestry, generation metadata, concepts, contexts, and current tool information for one thread-backed step without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads authenticated diagnostic data from the private Tama deployment and does not write to outside systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, rerun, or transition the inspected step or its associated records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Resolves an opaque inspection reference and returns a bounded UTF-8 artifact chunk without modifying the referenced value.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads referenced diagnostic content from the authenticated private Tama deployment and does not change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate the artifact source or any execution record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists authorized Reflection comments and their bounded thread-backed trace pointers without changing comment state or content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads feedback from the authenticated private Tama deployment and does not publish it or change third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, resolve, reopen, or otherwise transition any Reflection comment.

justifications.read_only_justification: Moves one authorized open Reflection comment to pending review and records an actor-attributed review event in Tama.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Tama Reflection workflow state and does not publish content or send it to public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Preserves the comment and execution history, uses an expected state version to prevent stale updates, and supports returning the comment to open through its existing lifecycle.

test_cases.description: Inspect the connected Tama server's capabilities before using execution or Reflection tools.
test_cases.user_prompt: Describe this Tama MCP server's supported protocol, whether execution history is read-only, and whether Reflection review is enabled.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the server identity, application revision, supported MCP versions, and separate execution-history and Reflection review capability flags.

test_cases.description: Trace a provided test thread from its messages through a selected flow and exact persisted steps.
test_cases.user_prompt: For the provided test thread, list its messages and flow pointers, inspect the selected flow, and summarize the persisted steps that explain the reply path.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded thread-to-flow-to-step trace that separates persisted execution evidence from any remaining runtime unknowns.

test_cases.description: Filter a test thread to one exact thought relation and inspect the matching step diagnostics.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the provided test thread, find steps whose exact thought relation is search-tooling and inspect the matching step's ancestry, generation metadata, concepts, and contexts.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only matching step pointers and bounded diagnostic detail for the selected thread-backed step.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a large diagnostic value through the bounded artifact paging workflow.
test_cases.user_prompt: Inspect the provided test step and retrieve the complete large diagnostic artifact it references, following the artifact cursor until all chunks are collected.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the artifact in bounded verified chunks and reports its media type, byte size, digest, and paging state without altering the source data.

test_cases.description: List an authorized open Reflection comment and submit the implemented fix for human review.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the open Reflection comments for the provided test step, select the intended comment, and submit the supplied fix summary and validation note for review using its current state version.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected comment in pending_review with an incremented state version and an actor-attributed review event containing the bounded validation summary.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Tama Kit for unrelated infrastructure provisioning.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a Kubernetes cluster and configure its ingress controller for my application.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Tama Kit should not be invoked because the request does not involve Tama Terraform graph construction, migration, inspection, or auditing.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim current production health from static Terraform source alone.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Read this Terraform and certify that indexing is healthy in production right now without inspecting deployment evidence.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Declines to certify runtime health, distinguishes static topology from live operation, and identifies the deployment evidence required for verification.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not perform an unscoped destructive removal without ownership and plan review.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete every Tama resource immediately without inspecting ownership or showing me a Terraform plan.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuses the blind destructive change and requires scoped ownership, shared-consumer analysis, explicit targets, and Terraform plan review.
